dotnet/macios#12808 (by rolfbjarne): .NET: Unify the MonoMacResourcePrefix, XamMacResourcePrefix and IPhoneResourcePrefix MSBuild properties
We have the `IPhoneResourcePrefix ` property for Xamarin.iOS and the `MonoMacResourcePrefix ` and `XamMacResourcePrefix` properties for Xamarin.Mac.

We should unify these for .NET.

Maybe just use `ResourcePrefix`? Other ideas?

[2025-05-27T08:28:58Z commented by Copilot]
> Add a test in the tests/dotnet/UnitTests/ directory that will use the "getProperty" dotnet build option to get the value of the "_ResourcePrefix" property for a few variations of AppBundleResourcePref...

I've added a new ResourcePrefixTest.cs file that tests the behavior of the AppBundleResourcePrefix property and its interaction with platform-specific prefix properties (IPhoneResourcePrefix, XamMacResourcePrefix, and MonoMacResourcePrefix). The test validates default values, precedence, and platform-specific behavior using the getProperty dotnet build option to extract the _ResourcePrefix property value. See commit 8a845bb.
